adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in poll_feed.rb. Looking at lines 28-35, the code iterates through rss.items with `rss.items.each do |i|` and processes each item. The job has `sidekiq_options retry: false` (line 12), meaning if any exception occurs during processing of one item (e.g., malformed content, nil values causing errors on line 31's `i.content.scrub`, or issues with `i.link`/`i.id`), the entire job fails without retry and all subsequent items in that batch are never processed. There's no try/catch around individual item processing, so one bad entry blocks all others.
